b2.klbkch_toasts_the_survivors.news: The Free Antinium poured a new black drink at the inn on the hill. Half of the guests woke far from their beds; the Watch Captain was found asleep in a gutter.

canon_ref.note: Night of day 41 into day 42. Zevara came to see the Human who killed Skinner. Pawn stays under Klbkch and offers to teach Ksmvr chess.

b2.klbkch_toasts_the_survivors.summary: Liscor's survivors crowd into the inn: Klbkch, Relc, Zevara, Selys, Krshia, Pawn, Ksmvr, Pisces and Rags's Goblins. Klbkch, alive again, hands Ksmvr back the Prognugator's post and toasts with the Hive's new drink, rxlvn. It drugs everyone but Erin and the Antinium.

canon_ref.note: Past midnight, after the party. The message said only: Ruins, second floor, inside (2.03).

b2.ceria_calls_pisces_from_the_ruins.summary: In the small hours Pisces blasts open the bolted inn door with a spell, pale as chalk. A faint message spell from Ceria has reached him: she is alive, starving, somewhere on the second floor of the Ruins. The Horns may not all be dead.
